dogecoin.text: I woke up and Dogecoin is down? On Doge day of all days? Human nature and the desire for profit never changes lmao.

When I wake up, I'm sure I'll laugh hysterically at whatever Dogecoin ends up at. I still can't believe people think that cryptocurrency is anything but a fiat speculative commodity with no agency backing.

It's literal magic money and surely the bubble will burst soon.
